items.name: Oil Drum
items.description: A dented little drum of engine oil. Thrown, it splits and slicks everything it lands on. Oil and fire don't stay apart for long.

items.name: Ember Pot
items.description: A clay-lined canister of live coals from a reactor vent. It bursts into flame on impact.

items.name: Coolant Keg
items.description: Frosted-over keg of reactor coolant. It frosts whatever it splashes, and boils into steam if fire meets it.

items.name: Brine Jug
items.description: Salt brine from the desalinators. It carries a current far too well, and freezes hard with coolant.

items.name: Grit Sack
items.description: A sack of blasting grit swept from the hull yards. It scours and blinds, and turns oil into sucking sludge.
